text: Implemented distinct PathLength and reusable WeightedEdgeLengths semantics, nonnegative primitive edge columns with exact SourceRef.Edge diagnostics, adjacency-to-edge indexing, deterministic Dijkstra APSP, zero-length paths, plan-identity mismatch protection, and checked relevant-overflow handling. Verified standard 32/32 on JVM/JS/Native and engine 100/100; weighted Dijkstra agrees with an independent Floyd denotation.
